dataset.name: Northwestern T1 bladder BCG cohort (GSE154261)
dataset.description: Independent high-grade stage-T1 bladder-cancer cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA sequencing and individual recurrence follow-up after BCG.
dataset.cohort_context: The discovery cohort contains 73 primary stage-T1 bladder tumors treated at one institution. The source study prespecified recurrence after bacillus Calmette-Guerin as its primary endpoint and profiled the tumors before outcome ascertainment. A separate 26-tumor early-cystectomy validation cohort is not included because GEO does not publish individual recurrence follow-up for those profiles.

metadata.source_program: Northwestern University high-grade T1 non-muscle-invasive bladder-cancer cohort
metadata.library_method: FFPE primary-tumor RNA aligned to GRCh38.p12 with STAR 2.6.0a and quantified against Ensembl release 95 with HTSeq 0.11.2
metadata.endpoint_context: Recurrence after repeat transurethral resection and induction BCG, with maintenance BCG reported by the source
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO provides recurrence status and a recurrence-or-follow-up time in months. The exact calendar origin is not restated, so TRACE Explorer exposes the endpoint as source-provided recurrence-free survival rather than equating it with a TCGA-CDR endpoint.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only the 73 source-labelled discovery-cohort tumors have both the pinned raw-count matrix and individual endpoint records. The 26 validation profiles are excluded before endpoint and expression QC.
metadata.overlap_note: The cohort is institutionally independent of TCGA-BLCA. The 26 early-cystectomy validation profiles belong to the same publication but are not counted as a second release.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Primary high-grade stage-T1 bladder tumor sampled before BCG outcome ascertainment

expression.label: GEO HTSeq counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 95 GRCh38 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without a source-defined rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes each retained library size over all 58,735 source Ensembl rows, converts raw counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are suitable for within-cohort analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-provided recurrence-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: After BCG treatment; exact calendar origin not restated by the source
endpoints.event_definition: Documented bladder-cancer recurrence; patients without recurrence are censored at source-provided follow-up
